title: Mike Hall moves past training camp incident with Quinshon Judkins

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Hall moves past training camp incident with Quinshon Judkins
sources.description: Browns defensive tackle Mike Hall and running back Quinshon Judkins had a bit of a dust up in training camp, with the incident apparently causing Hall to miss nearly three weeks of practice.
